- `POST /users` with body `{bad json` → unhandled rejection (`SyntaxError`).
- `PATCH /users/%` with body `{"name":"x"}` → unhandled rejection (`URIError`).

Fix at the source: wrap the handler, e.g. `http.createServer((req, res) => { route(req, res).catch((err) => send(res, 400, { error: "bad request" })); })`, and/or try/catch around the `readJson` and `decodeURIComponent` call sites.
